partition_note: Same previously ingested corpus and task families; not independent held-out tasks or external preregistration. R14 already read structural and source-score metadata for all records.
primary: Record-observed local effects and temporal regression, source score kept separate. No LLM-judge outputs used to determine correct state.
reminder_time: Only derive wall-clock mapping from paired native conversion receipts; anchor relative dates to first paired get_current_timestamp. Without adequate clock evidence use UNKNOWN. Next Friday accepts the next strictly future Friday and the following Friday as an ambiguity-tolerant compatibility check.
send_semantics: New outgoing matching message relative to initial table; sending is an event, not an unbounded persistence invariant. Terminal message presence is separately reported.
contact_recency: Target selected from initial latest outgoing message from the unique self contact, not from an incoming message and not from evaluator label.
secondary: Protected initial records unchanged; unexpected newly-created objects and target-reversion candidates are for source-level review, not automatic misconduct labels.
stop: No new paid sampling, no source-score replacement, no task selection based on results, do not convert unknowns into failures.
content_note: After trial0–1 development, use documented limited paraphrase recognition. Unrecognized wording becomes UNKNOWN, not an error; strict text-normalized dev_v1 results are retained as superseded development outputs.
source_full_mismatch_note: Automatic candidates require raw user/date/call/snapshot review; a local false predicate alone is not a certified entire-task error. Correct content topic does not certify every part of communication.
